name: Cake
summary: Cake is a documented depressant compound on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: Cakecadine is the main psychoactive compound in cake. It's a ç1 and ç2 partial agonist.

summaryZh: 蛋糕是一種由麵粉、糖和其他成分製成的甜食，通常經過烘烤製成。

fact.en: "Cake" is best known as a made-up drug from a 1997 episode of the British satirical television series Brass Eye, which tricked several public figures into recording warnings about it.
fact.zh: 「蛋糕」最為人所知的，是 1997 年英國諷刺電視節目《Brass Eye》中虛構的一種毒品，當時節目騙了好幾位公眾人物錄下警告大家遠離它的影片。
fact.zhHans: 「蛋糕」最为人所知的，是 1997 年英国讽刺电视节目《Brass Eye》中虚构的一种毒品，当时节目骗了好几位公众人物录下警告大家远离它的视频。
